<subject>Catherine Storey for Compliance Advisory Engagements</subject>
<body>
I spoke with each of you a couple of weeks ago, and this matter was set aside due to other urgent priorities. However, we all agreed that a standard cutoff time would be appropriate for UK and EU compliance advisory engagements.

The optimal approach will be to set the cutoff at 4pm daily (to gauge volume, I reviewed yesterday’s activity: we had three UK engagements and two EU cross-border advisory mandates initiated after 4pm London time). After 4pm, any new Compliance Advisory engagements would automatically roll to the next business day. For matters that do not proceed past 4pm, respective oversight teams must treat them as the following day’s responsibility. I’m uncertain how [ORG_1]’s internal reporting protocols would need adjustment, as the official matter logs would exclude these late submissions. Can [ORG_1] generate supplemental reports to ensure teams have accurate matter positions each morning?

I would appreciate your feedback, and in any case, please confirm that a 4pm cutoff remains workable for your respective units.

Danielle  
x36557

Eric – any potential issues with the Daily Position Report?  
Mary – we touched on this briefly a few weeks ago…any further thoughts?
</body>
